selection: retain and score all repetitions; no best-of selection
retry_allowed: completed provider response with no recoverable JSON experiment envelope
retry_forbidden: recoverable experiment output with schema violations
schema_delivery_boundary: Retry only when no JSON object with claims list and questions list can be recovered from a completed text response. Claim/payload/citation/question/context violations are retained experiment outputs, not delivery retries.
B4_repetitions: one replay for each corresponding stored B3 repetition; no provider call
B0_repetitions: deterministic output retained once; reference the same artifact for the three aligned slots, never claim three independent B0 generations
